title: Google Ads Transparency Center Scraper input

searchQueries.title: Advertiser names or domains to search
searchQueries.description: Free-text searches, exactly like the search box on adstransparency.google.com. Brand names (`Nike`) or domains (`nike.com`). The best-matching advertisers are scraped (see *Max advertisers per query*).

advertiserIds.title: Advertiser IDs
advertiserIds.description: Advertiser IDs starting with `AR` (from Ads Transparency URLs like `/advertiser/AR12345678901234567890`). Scraped in addition to search results.

advertiserUrls.title: Advertiser or creative URLs
advertiserUrls.description: Full URLs copied from adstransparency.google.com, e.g. `https://adstransparency.google.com/advertiser/AR.../?region=US`.

domains.title: Domains (all advertisers)
domains.description: Website domains, e.g. `nike.com`. Returns ads from ANY advertiser that link to this domain (Google's 'search by website' view). Uses *Max ads per advertiser* as the limit per domain.

maxAdvertisersPerQuery.title: Max advertisers per query
maxAdvertisersPerQuery.description: How many matching advertisers to scrape for each search query (best matches first).

maxAdsPerAdvertiser.title: Max ads per advertiser
maxAdsPerAdvertiser.description: Maximum number of ads (creatives) to collect per advertiser, newest first. 40 ads per page.

format.title: Ad format
format.description: Only return ads of this format.

regions.title: Regions (country codes)
regions.description: Only ads shown in these countries, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (`US`, `GB`, `DE`, `KR`...). Empty = anywhere.

startDate.title: Shown after
startDate.description: Only ads shown on or after this date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

endDate.title: Shown before
endDate.description: Only ads shown on or before this date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

topic.title: Topic
topic.description: `POLITICAL` restricts to election/political ads (where Google provides that view).

includeAdText.title: Extract ad copy (text, links, images)
includeAdText.description: Extract the ad copy for each ad. Text ads are published by Google only as screenshots, so their text is read with OCR (see next option); video ads yield the YouTube video ID and thumbnail. One or two extra requests per ad, charged as a separate event only when something is extracted.

ocrAdText.title: OCR screenshot ads
ocrAdText.description: Read the text of ads that Google publishes only as rendered screenshots (most Search text ads) with Tesseract OCR. Adds ~1 s per ad.

includeAdvertiserInfo.title: Include advertiser profile items
includeAdvertiserInfo.description: Push one `type: "advertiser"` item per advertiser with name, ID, legal name, region and approximate ad count.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Google shows a CAPTCHA wall after ~20 requests from one IP, so Apify Proxy (rotating datacenter IPs) is enabled by default. Keep it on unless you run very small jobs.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Log raw responses for troubleshooting. Leave off.
